title: Lake Reintaler See Kramsach
name: Lake Reintaler See Kramsach
kurzbeschreibung: The Reintaler See in Kramsach: warmest swimming lake in Tyrol at up to 25 °C, featuring sunbathing lawns, boat rentals, a circular trail, and lakeside restaurants.
beschreibung:
Overview

The popular Reintaler See is located in the Tyrolean Unterinntal in the municipality of Kramsach (district of Kufstein) at an elevation of around 564 meters above sea level. Nestled within the sunny Kramsach lake plateau at the foot of the mighty Rofangebirge, the Reintaler See covers a surface area of over 29 hectares, making it the largest body of water in the region. Thanks to its sheltered basin location, the lake warms up during the summer months to pleasant water temperatures of up to 25 degrees Celsius, rightfully earning its reputation as one of Tyrol's warmest and most appealing natural bathing lakes.

Swimming Fun, Boat Rental & Circular Path

The lakeshore is superbly developed for recreation seekers: expansive, manicured sunbathing lawns on the northern and southern shores provide both sunny and shaded spots beneath mature deciduous trees. Families appreciate gently sloping non-swimmer zones, children's playgrounds, and modern pedal boat and rowboat rentals. Anglers value the abundant fish population of pike, carp, and zander in the natural eastern basin. A fully barrier-free, paved circular trail around the lake spanning approximately four kilometers invites visitors for leisurely strolls all year round (walking time approx. one hour). Informational display boards along the path explain the local birdlife and the formation of the Kramsach lake landscape as a relic of the last Ice Age.

Visit & Getting There

The beach lidos at Reintaler See are open daily during the swimming season from mid-May to mid-September (sunbathing lawn admission approx. €4.50 for adults, children approx. €2.50; admission is discounted or free with the regional Alpbachtal Card). Outside the managed lidos, the shore trail remains freely accessible free of charge. Getting there by car: Via the Inntalautobahn A12 (exit Kramsach/Brixlegg), continue on the L211 toward Kramsach Seen; several large paid parking lots are located directly on the lakeshores. By public transport: Take the ÖBB train to Brixlegg station, from where regional bus route 4075 runs several times daily directly to stops at Reintaler See.

Tips

The circular lakeside path is completely flat and ideally suited for strollers and wheelchair users. Stop by the traditional Restaurant Fischerstube or Camping Seeblick Toni to savor regional Tyrolean delicacies and ice cream specialties on the lakeside terrace overlooking the Rofangebirge.
